comparison.prior_guidance: Used Playwright for user-visible flows but did not explicitly distinguish responsive viewports from independent browser state or require convergence coverage.
comparison.revised_guidance: Triggers a deterministic two-context plan when shared client copies, live counters/timers, collaboration, offline recovery, wake/reconnect, reload, deletion, or reset can diverge.

prompts.query: Two operators can tap the same live packaging counter at once; add a regression that proves one result persists and both screens converge.
The SSE client now reconciles after Android wakes from background; test a stale offline browser and a receiving browser through reconnect and reload.
prompts.reason: Independent stale client and wake recovery.

prompts.query: A reset tombstone must not be resurrected by a sleeping tab; create the isolated two-context browser scenario and retain device-labeled evidence.
The timer and autosave changed, and the bug only appears when an auto tick races a manual edit from another station; plan the smallest multi-device coverage.
Make the settings card responsive at 390px and 1280px; no shared state or second session is involved.
Add a unit test for the pure cases-per-skid calculation.
prompts.reason: Pure logic belongs in a focused unit test.

prompts.query: Verify that a manager can open the schedule dialog; only one signed-in browser and authorization are under test.
Load-test sync with 500 clients and measure throughput.
prompts.reason: Load testing is outside the browser convergence lane.
